name: Primitive Launcher
subtitle: Your home screen for the Kindle
description: Primitive Launcher replaces the Kindle's shop-style home screen with a calm grid of your apps. It has quick settings, Wi-Fi, SSH and DNS, display, sleep, power, USB drive mode and an optional start at boot. Leaving it returns to Amazon's interface.

changes.notes: Writes its boot job to /etc/upstart while the root filesystem is writable, only when it changes.

versions.notes: Use the approved Store and native app icons in the Launcher grid. Apps can still supply their own icons.
